A small update that keeps CurseForge working.

## Update to keep CurseForge

The addon browser reaches CurseForge through this project's own server. From this version, that server only answers WoW Foreverywhere's official releases, so **earlier versions no longer show CurseForge addons**. WoWInterface and the GitHub catalog keep working in every version.

Updating to this version brings CurseForge back. Nothing else changes, and your settings, saved login, game files and addons are kept.

## Install

Download **WoW-Foreverywhere.apk** below, or use **Settings → Update app** inside the app. If you installed an earlier version from this page, it installs as an update.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere other than this page. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.
